context: Hina shows Sachiko the flowers she grew herself.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、花、咲いた、見て。
lines.style: Bright, clear opening on 'Grandma' with immediate excitement. Eager bounce in the rhythm. Genuine childlike wonder — not performed. Soft breathiness under the pride. Sustained eye contact through the whole line.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: わあ、可愛い、頑張ったね。
lines.en: Oh, how lovely! You took such good care of it.
lines.style: Warm exhale on the opening. Soft, nodding tone. Each phrase lands gently — appreciative, not gushing. The voice of someone who sees the real effort behind the bloom. Slight lingering smile in the trailing words.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 毎日、優しく、お世話、した。
lines.en: Every single day I was gentle with it. I really looked after it.
lines.style: Steady, proud-warm delivery. Each phrase distinct and clear — she's reporting her work. Soft emphasis on the care itself. Still childlike but also serious about what she did. No rush, just sincere recounting.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.en: We watched over it together, didn't we.
lines.style: Quiet, tender reflection. Slower pace. Soft focus on 'together' — acknowledging what the child did and the bond it created. Philosophical without being heavy. Voice settles at the end like a closing door.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Simple, unadorned joy. Each word lands softly. The 'truly' carries weight — not exaggerated, just genuine. A child's contentment that knows what it means. Gentle fade at the very end, like she's savoring the feeling.
